topic: Freezing your credit during a breakup vs leaving it open (Ava vs Mia)

scenes.narration: Her ex moved out in March. In September a Lexus dealership called her about the missed payments. I am Judge Vera and today two breakups end very differently. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the bench pointing her gavel at a giant comic banner reading LEXUS BILL FOR HER, a phone ringing on the bench, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ava and Mia each break up with a long term partner who knows their full name, social security number, and birthday by heart.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, left side woman ava packing a moving box in a doorway, right side woman mia handing keys back to a partner, both with sad and serious expressions, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ava trusts her ex, keeps her credit unfrozen, and never changes the passwords on her email or her bank.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman ava on a couch scrolling on a phone, an open laptop on a table with email and bank tabs unlocked, a small comic banner reads SAME PASSWORDS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Mia goes online that same week and freezes her credit at all three bureaus, changes every password, and turns on bank alerts for any new account.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman mia at a kitchen table on a laptop with three browser tabs labeled EQUIFAX EXPERIAN TRANSUNION all stamped FROZEN, a phone showing a NEW ACCOUNT ALERT toggle on, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Six months later Ava gets a call from a Lexus dealership asking why she stopped paying on the forty thousand dollar auto loan she never signed.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked woman ava on a phone in her kitchen, a giant red comic banner reading FORTY THOUSAND LOAN looms behind her, a paper labeled MISSED PAYMENT on the table, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Mia gets a credit freeze alert that someone tried to open a card in her name and the bureau blocked it instantly. No damage, no debt, no fight.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split scene, left side ava holding a thick collection letter, right side mia smiling at a phone showing an alert reading APPLICATION BLOCKED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The day a relationship ends, freeze your credit at all three bureaus and change every password. A freeze is free, takes ten minutes, and stops the next chapter from costing you forty thousand dollars. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel, holding a checklist labeled FREEZE ALL THREE BUREAUS, comic burst banner reads COURT DISMISSED, kids comic book illustration
